AAD.caption: Value
AAD.doc: Exact match: the incoming token to compare with the Secret. HMAC: the signature received from the provider (e.g. the X-Hub-Signature-256 or X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256 header).
AAD.name: value

AAG.caption: Mode
AAG.doc: Exact match compares Value with the Secret. HMAC computes an HMAC of Payload with the Secret and compares it with the signature in Value.
AAG.name: mode

AAH.caption: Payload
AAH.doc: HMAC only: the exact content the provider signed, usually the raw request body. Re-serialised JSON will not match.
AAH.name: payload

AAI.caption: Algorithm
AAI.doc: HMAC only: the hash algorithm the provider uses.
AAI.name: algorithm

AAJ.caption: Signature encoding
AAJ.doc: HMAC only: how the signature in Value is encoded (GitHub and Stripe use Hex, Shopify uses Base64).
AAJ.name: encoding

AAK.caption: Signature prefix
AAK.doc: HMAC only, optional: a prefix to strip from Value before comparing, e.g. sha256= for GitHub.
AAK.name: signature_prefix
